stories.title: Recordregen en overstromingen treffen Barcelona en omstreken: twee doden door noodweer

en.title: Record rainfall and floods strike Barcelona and surroundings: two dead from severe weather
en.summary: Barcelona and its surrounding areas experienced record rainfall and flooding, resulting in two deaths from the severe weather event.

stories.title: Gewonden bij brand op camping Gardameer, vakantiegangers helpen brandweer

en.title: Injured in fire at Lake Garda campsite, holidaymakers help firefighters
en.summary: At least twenty people were injured in a fire at a large campsite on Lake Garda's south shore that destroyed multiple caravans and vehicles. Firefighters were assisted by volunteers during the blaze.

stories.title: 24 gewonden bij grote brand op camping Gardameer

en.title: 24 injured in major fire at Lake Garda campsite
en.summary: A large fire at an Italian Lake Garda campsite injured 24 people on Sunday morning, and the fire has been brought under control.

stories.title: Twee mannen gewond bij steekpartij Leidens Ontzet, verdachten weggerend

en.title: Two men injured in stabbing at Leiden Relief, suspects fled
en.summary: Two men aged 19 and 22 were wounded in a stabbing near a festival in central Leiden following a confrontation between youth groups. The suspects fled the scene and no arrests have been made.

stories.title: Twee doden bij recordhoeveelheid regen en hevige overstromingen in Catalonië

en.title: Two dead in record rainfall and severe flooding in Catalonia
en.summary: Record-breaking rain caused severe flooding in Catalonia overnight Saturday to Sunday, resulting in two deaths. Streets and roads around Barcelona were inundated, and dozens of people required rescue from vehicles.

stories.title: Doden door noodweer in Catalonië, brandweer redt mensen uit auto's

en.title: Deaths from severe weather in Catalonia, firefighters rescue people from cars
en.summary: Severe rainfall in Spain's Catalonia region killed two people, with some areas experiencing their wettest day in twenty years. A 65-year-old man died when a wall collapsed at a campsite, while another fatality occurred in Montornès del Vallès.

stories.title: Twee mensen neergestoken bij gevecht tussen jongeren tijdens Leidens Ontzet

en.title: Two people stabbed in fight between youths during Leidens Ontzet
en.summary: Two people were injured in a stabbing incident Saturday evening in Leiden during festivities marking Leidens Ontzet, a historical commemoration.

stories.title: Pro-Oekraïense premier wint verkiezingen in Letland met ruime voorsprong

en.title: Pro-Ukrainian premier wins Latvian elections by wide margin
en.summary: Latvia's pro-Ukrainian premier Andris Kulbergs won Saturday's parliamentary elections by a large margin and will exclude the pro-Russian second-largest party from coalition negotiations.

en.title: Holocaust survivor Irene Butter deceased
en.summary: Irene Butter, who witnessed the persecution of Jews in the Netherlands as a child and was acquainted with Anne Frank, has died. The peace activist wrote a book documenting her experiences during this period.

stories.title: Amerikaanse universiteit belooft maatregelen na aanklacht groepsverkrachting

en.title: American university pledges measures after group rape allegation
en.summary: Cornell University's rector announced steps following accusations that students committed group rape in 2024, in which a woman was allegedly drugged and assaulted for hours. An independent investigation will be conducted.

stories.title: Rector Cornell University belooft maatregelen na heropening zaak groepsverkrachting

en.title: Cornell rector promises measures after reopening of gang rape case
en.summary: The rector of Cornell University announced measures following the reopening of a gang rape case involving students at the institution.

stories.title: Rector Cornell belooft beterschap na aanklacht groepsverkrachting door studenten

en.title: Cornell rector promises improvement after student group rape allegation
en.summary: Cornell University's rector expressed deep concern over allegations of student group rape and acknowledged the university's response troubled many. He pledged improvements and noted the incident raises serious questions about sexual violence and campus culture.
